en: Which mark ends this sentence? “Where is my bag___”
It asks something, so it needs a question mark.
Which mark ends this sentence? “I have a red umbrella___”
It tells us something, so it ends with a full stop.
Which mark ends this sentence? “What a big wave___”
It shows surprise, so it ends with an exclamation mark.
Which list has the commas in the right places?
I like apples, pears and grapes.
I like, apples pears and grapes.
I like apples pears, and, grapes.
Put a comma between the things in a list, but not before “and”.
Which is written correctly?
Do you like snow?
Do you like snow.
Do you, like snow?
It is a question, so it needs a question mark and no comma.
Which mark ends this sentence? “How old are you___”
It asks a question, so it ends with a question mark.
Which mark ends this sentence? “Watch out___”
It is a warning shout, so it ends with an exclamation mark.
Which list has the commas in the right places?
We saw a lion, a zebra and a giraffe.
We saw a lion a zebra, and, a giraffe.
We saw, a lion a zebra and a giraffe.
The comma goes between a lion and a zebra. “And” joins the last two.
What does a question mark show?
the sentence asks something
the sentence is a list
the sentence is very quiet
A question mark goes at the end of a sentence that asks something.
Which is written correctly?
The bus is late today.
The bus is, late today.
the bus is late today
It starts with a capital, ends with a full stop and needs no comma.
Which mark ends this sentence? “Can you swim___”
It asks something, so it ends with a question mark.
Which mark ends this sentence? “The cat is asleep___”
It tells us something, so it ends with a full stop.
Which mark ends this sentence? “Hooray, we won___”
It is a happy shout, so it ends with an exclamation mark.
Which list has the commas in the right places?
I packed a hat, a scarf and gloves.
I packed, a hat a scarf and gloves.
I packed a hat a scarf, and, gloves.
The comma goes between a hat and a scarf. “And” joins the last two.
Which is written correctly?
Where is the dog?
Where is the dog.
where is the dog?
It is a question, so it starts with a capital and ends with a question mark.
Which mark ends this sentence? “Which colour do you like best___”
It asks a question, so it ends with a question mark.
Which mark ends this sentence? “My kite is blue___”
It tells us something, so it ends with a full stop.
Which mark ends this sentence? “What a lovely party___”
It shows surprise and joy, so it ends with an exclamation mark.
Which list has the commas in the right places?
Mum bought bananas, plums and grapes.
Mum bought bananas plums, and, grapes.
Mum, bought bananas plums and grapes.
Put a comma between the things in the list, but not before “and”.
What does a full stop show?
the end of a telling sentence
the sentence asks something
the sentence is a shout
A full stop goes at the end of a sentence that tells us something.
Which is written correctly?
I can see a rainbow.
I can see a rainbow?
i can see a rainbow.
It tells us something, so it ends with a full stop, and I is a capital.
Which mark ends this sentence? “When does the film start___”
It asks a question, so it ends with a question mark.
Which mark ends this sentence? “Quick, run for the bus___”
It is a shout to hurry, so it ends with an exclamation mark.
What does an exclamation mark show?
a shout or surprise
a question
a list
An exclamation mark goes at the end of a shout or a surprise.
Which list has the commas in the right places?
The flag is red, white and blue.
The flag is red white, and, blue.
The flag, is red white and blue.
The comma goes between red and white. “And” joins the last two.
Which is written correctly?
Is it time for lunch?
Is it time for lunch.
Is it, time for lunch?
It is a question, so it needs a question mark and no comma.
Which mark goes between the things in a list?
a comma
a question mark
an exclamation mark
Commas split up the things in a list.
Which mark ends this sentence? “Our class has twenty children___”
It tells us something, so it ends with a full stop.
Which is written correctly?
We had a fun day at the zoo.
We had a fun day at the zoo?
We had, a fun day at the zoo.
It tells us something, so it ends with a full stop and needs no comma.
Which list has the commas in the right places?
At the farm we saw cows, pigs and sheep.
At the farm we saw, cows pigs and sheep.
At the farm we saw cows pigs, and, sheep.
The comma goes between cows and pigs. “And” joins the last two.

example.q_en: Which mark ends this sentence? “Where is my bag___”
example.why_en: It asks something, so it needs a question mark.

en.title: Full stops, question marks and commas
en.teach: A telling sentence ends with a full stop. A question ends with a question mark. A shout or surprise ends with an exclamation mark. Commas split up a list: red, blue and green.
